race.comment: HIDDEN NEWS (6) found the 900m too short on debut when he warmed up late to finish fourth over 900m at this track. Jumps out quickly in trip from the good gate and expected to go close. WAN LOST (2) well-bred Zoustar gelding who finally comes up with a good barrier. Savaged the line from back in the field for a narrow second over 1200m at Tuncurry. Can stalk the speed and shed his Maiden tag at start seven. PIERATA MAGIC (13) three-year-old Pierata filly out of River Bird on debut for the Widdup yard. Had a stack of trials in readiness for this and gets every chance from the low draw. WAVE BLASTER (14) returned from a lengthy break with a disappointing eighth over 1200m in a Warwick Farm Super Maiden. Finds a much easier contest and worth thought.
